subject: Signal and System
questionText:
Let x(t) be a continuous-time, real-valued signal 
band-limited to F Hz. The Nyquist sampling rate, in 
Hz, for y(t) = x(0.5t) + x(t) – x(2t) is 
 
(a) F 
(b) 2F 
 
(c) 4F 
(d) 8F 𝜋
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-28 (Sampling and It’s Type).
